verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no settlement or balance reports, per-seller or rolled up, delivered as files or via a reporting API on a schedule. The batch-close API is described as making reconciliation easier, but it is a settlement-timing control, not reconciliation reporting. General event webhooks and a Dashboard 'reporting console' mention are adjacent features and do not show report delivery that a finance stack can consume.

support.subject: As a developer, reconciliation is automatable — settlement and balance reports per seller and rolled up, delivered as files or APIs my finance stack consumes on schedule
